one_liner: Zoho Cliq has a broad REST API (v2 documented here) with OAuth 2.0 and a vendor-documented official MCP server. Free-plan API access isn't confirmed by the pages.
auth_notes: The REST API page says authentication uses OAuth 2.0. The draft's API_KEY claim (integration-component tokens) came from a page not provided, so I removed it. The MCP page's 'API Key Re-Generate' button regenerates the MCP URL and is not a Cliq REST credential. Multiple datacenter domains apply.
access_notes: Self-serve sign-up exists. The pages don't show plan or pricing details, so I can't confirm that a free plan includes API access. This is the most defensible value with low confidence.
blocker_notes: Minor: per-datacenter handling is needed (9 domains). Free-plan API availability is unconfirmed.
